candidates.requirement: Update the existing XInclude malloc-failure check to use the error channel that the changed memory-error helper actually sets.
candidates.target_route: Supply a well-formed document with an xi:include and set the encoded allocation limit to the ordinal of xmlXIncludeNewRef's allocation, after parsing and context creation. The fuzzer's one-shot failure reaches xmlXIncludeErrMemory; processing then reports no fallback before the harness checks xmlXIncludeGetLastError.
candidates.failure_condition: fuzzAllocFailed is true, while the XInclude context's errNo is not XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY, so the existing xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.
candidates.alternative_paths: The helper sets the global error, but the existing check reads the XInclude context. The later no-fallback error can set errNo to a different code; no target call reconciles these values.

candidates.requirement: Exercise the new per-context structured error-handler route on the XInclude context used by this target.
candidates.target_route: After xmlXIncludeNewContext, register a structured handler and data before xmlXIncludeProcessNode. A well-formed document containing an xi:include with an unsupported parse value reaches an XInclude error through the target's existing processing operation.
candidates.failure_condition: The old target never calls xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler, so every input leaves errorHandler null and cannot execute the new per-context callback route.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target installs only a generic global error function. That does not populate the XInclude context's handler and data, and no input changes the target's call sequence.
